text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After the concert, the Umamusume praise
each other's efforts in the race, singing and dancing, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You know that different styles of dance
use different muscles, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, then you understand, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Which means live concert venues are...
the absolute best place for observation!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Muscles dynamically pulsing, showing a different side with every dance!
Rising body temperature, racing heartbeat, surging pulse!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...However, if I dance,
I won't be able to watch properly, will I?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Assuming you'll do the filming,
I wonder if there's any other way we could approach this.
choice_data_list: Or like, boosting Insight or something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you consider how much you gain from just a little information,
it might take some mental energy, but it's not a bad deal.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
First, let's build foundational stamina to reduce
the strain during observations and give yourself some leeway.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided... Trainer-kun!
Perform a pantomime!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
While we dance,
let me guess what you're acting out!

To help with Agnes Tachyon's... dance lesson?
I ended up pantomiming endlessly on stage...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
DVA dynamic visual acuity, and KVA dynamic visual acuity...
So the goal is to enhance visual function.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Fascinating!
My passion for research is truly surging, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, why don't we give it a try!
Trainer, take the stage!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Every single move you make—your gaze, even the sway of your hair!
I'll take it all in with these very eyes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So that one day, my eyes will be able
to capture even the realm of light-speed!!

To help improve Agnes Tachyon's dynamic visual acuity,
I was left dancing all by myself on stage...
